name: medplum-provider
description: PRIMARY fixture — the Medplum provider example app (React + Vite + TS on @medplum/core / @medplum/react, React Router, Mantine). Tests run fully offline against MockClient, so app-tests-pass needs no live Medplum server.

upstream.note: Vendored + pinned by vendor.mjs. Keep @medplum/{core,definitions,mock,fhirtypes} on matching versions; Node >= 22.4 (or a ws dev dep) for the WebSocket polyfill @medplum/core v5 needs at module load.

project.name: medplum-provider
project.stack_summary: React + Vite + TypeScript on @medplum/core / @medplum/react, React Router, Mantine; tests via Vitest + MockClient

vitestSetup.note: Both must be registered in vitest.config.* — globalSetup indexes FHIR bundles once and shares globalSchema.types to workers; setupFiles assigns the shared index at module scope. Without them, filtered searchResources silently return nothing.

liveStack.note: Off by default. For server-only behavior (access policies, subscriptions, $everything, bots, GraphQL/transaction edges) bring up the full stack via Docker and run graders as integration checks. Slower + nondeterministic — reserve for contracts MockClient can't prove.

clean.description: App with NO ai-tools/, AGENTS.md, or vendor dirs. Drives S0 — Bootstrap.

stale.description: App bootstrapped against an OLDER vinta-ai-workflows version (deliberately behind current). Drives S1 — Sync.

current.description: App bootstrapped against the CURRENT version, harness fully in place. Drives S2–S4.

maintenance.staleCadence: Re-base `stale/` to 'current minus one meaningful change' each release so S1 keeps exercising a real upgrade rather than a no-op. Cheapest: regenerate from clean/ by bootstrapping with a pinned older package version (see states.stale.bootstrappedFrom).
